verdicts.evidence: At first the author deferred this to WA-2928. They then fixed it in PR commit d85b9e6ba: useHasUntrustedFallbackHandler.ts now calls identifyOfficialFallbackHandler, which checks both the Compatibility and ExtensibleFallbackHandler deployments.

At 6c592b0, transaction-guards.test.ts:387 hardcoded version '1.4.1'. In 6a5d47de2 the test was parameterised (l2SingletonVersion), and the author replied '(3) Parameterised — the 1.5.0 MultiSend case now migrates to the 1.5.0 L2 singleton.'
The author's reply answers points (1)-(3) but says nothing about point (4), the factory scanner / mainnet deployment remark. No commit changes anything for it.
